page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred. Text runs top to bottom; below the text three woodcut or stamp images (a round seal, an ornamental oval cartouche, a diamond-shaped library stamp). No margin notes. Digitiser banner at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.l: Authoritas, integritas, & sinceritas, à variis ejus
Quamplurima Loca à temerariis Censuris, & VARIA-

page.notes: Woodcut/stamp images below the text (round seal with "BIBLIOTHECA SOCIETATIS JESU"-style legend, ornamental oval cartouche, diamond library stamp reading "EMANUELE" / "VITTORIO" / "BIBLIOTECA" / "ROMA") are not transcribed as text. Handwritten pencil marks at top right ("102") and scattered specks are excluded. The stamp legends are partly illegible due to the scan. Lines with long-s rendered as "f" in the original ("Fil.", "Censuris", "Sacrosanctæ") are given with plain s where the printed form is s.
